name: PT Antam (Persero) Tbk
summary: PT Aneka Tambang Tbk, known as ANTAM, is an Indonesian mining and metals company with nickel, precious metals and refining, and bauxite and alumina divisions. It manages the whole value chain, from finding and extracting the ore to processing and selling it, for commodities such as nickel ore, ferronickel, gold, silver, coal, bauxite and alumina.
